messages:
viv (PM): Starting thread for rollout strategy of 'smalltalk-plus'. Aim: validate behavioral regressions and cost delta while limiting blast radius. Proposal: mesh canary (tiny slices across many tenants) + region waves, anomaly-based automated rollback, customer pause with 96h notice for enterprise. Need quick agreement on slice sizes, anomaly thresholds, and audit retention.

omar (Eng): Sketch: mesh slices 0.25% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50%. Each slice shadowed by stable model for token-delta comparison for first two ramps. Add a lightweight human-review flag if token-delta > 8% for any tenant.

rachel (SRE): Ops constraints: require circuit breaker if anomaly_score > 0.15 over 10m OR queue latency p95 > 400ms for 3m. Circuit trips -> immediate route to stable and notify oncall. Also propose a progressive connection drain (45s) to avoid KV churn.

leo (CS): Customer asks: per-tenant pause toggle + exportable diff report. Enterprise want 96h opt-out window and per-account audit retention (default 90d, enterprise up to 120d). They also requested a simple KPIs pack for acceptance (error-rate, latency, divergence).

tia (Sales): Heads-up: two prospects (RetailCo, FinStart) require region pin (EU only) and a preflight QA summary before enabling. We should surface expected cost delta between int8 and fp16.

legal-bot: Note: compliance team flagged need for record of who triggered pause and timestamp. Retention policy must be configurable per contract.

deploy-bot: Plan uploaded: /deploys/smalltalk-plus_v1 -> regions [eu-central-1, us-east-2] -> mesh canary slices [0.0025,0.02,0.10,0.5] -> shadow stable for first two slices -> automated anomaly rollback. Runbook: http://confluence.internal/smalltalk-plus/runbook

omar (Eng): Proposed flag YAML for ops record:

```yaml
feature: smalltalk_plus
scope: tenant
mesh_slices: [0.0025, 0.02, 0.10, 0.5]
shadow_first_n: 2
qa_gates:
  - metric: anomaly_score
    op: '>'
    value: 0.15
    window: 600s
  - metric: token_delta
    op: '>'
    value: 0.08
    window: 24h
fallback: stable_smalltalk_v0
audit: true
pause_api: true
```

rachel (SRE): Add global CPU backstop: cluster_cpu > 80% for 4m -> full rollback. We'll schedule a staged chaos run during 2% slice to validate.

viv (PM): Decisions needed: agree slices + anomaly thresholds, OK to ship pause API + audit hooks, and enterprise notice 96h. Target internal soft-launch in 3 weeks, public GA in 8.

leo (CS): I can handle customer comms and export templates. Confirm audit retention defaults and enterprise option.

tia (Sales): Approved from GTM if CS confirms templates and we get cost delta numbers.

omar (Eng): ETA: mesh orchestration + shadow comparator -> 2 sprints. Pause API + audit -> 1 sprint. Chaos + infra backstops -> 1 sprint.

rachel (SRE): I'll add backstop configs and queue thresholds in infra repo. Chaos job scheduled Friday. :shield:

viv (PM): Great — I'll update runbook with token-delta thresholds and human-review flow. Anyone object to moving forward?

(no further replies)
